༄༅/ /lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa las/ nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol bzhugs so//

rdo rje 'chang dbang bla ma la// rdo rje gsum gyis gus mchod nas// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa yi// nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol bri// phyi sgrub mtshan ma mthar phyin nas// nang ltar sgrub pa 'di lta ste// thog mar thun mong ma yin pa'i// dmigs pa'i dbang gis rgyud sbyangs nas// rang mdun gyad dang seng khri'i steng*// pad zla nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// longs sku nges pa lnga ldan tshul| |dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan pa// rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*// rdor dril 'dzin bsnol 'khyud pa'i pang*// rang 'dra'i yum mthing gri thod 'dzin// phyag zhabs yab la 'khril ba yi// yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral ba ru// oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po ni// rtsibs brgyad lte bar oṃ gyis mtshan// mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar// 'dab brgyad lte bar āḥdamar mtshan// thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje ni// rtse lnga mthing kha'i lte ba ru// hūm̐ mthing gsal gdab mchod pa 'bul// phyag dang maṇ+ḍal gus byas te// bstod cing mos gus gdung shugs kyis| |gsol ba phur tshugs btab pa'i tshe// yab yum dpral ba'i oṃ dkar las// bdud rtsi 'od dkar rang nyid kyi// dpral bar thim pas tha mal lus// sbyangs nas rdo rje'i sku ru bsam// yab yum mgrin pa'i āḥdamar las// bdud rtsi 'od dmar rgyun bab pa// rang mgrin thim pas tha mal ngag /sbyangs nas rdo rje'i gsung du bsam// yab yum thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthing las// bdud rtsi 'od mthing rang nyid kyi// snying khar thim pas tha mal sems// sbyangs nas rdo rje'i thugs su bsam// tha mar bla ma yab yum rnams// 'od zhu rang gi smin mtshams su// thim pas sgo gsum sgrib sbyangs nas// rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsam// de ni sngon 'gro'i dbang yin no// thun dang po'o// dngos gzhi 'di ltar dmigs par bya// rang gnas 'og min zhing khams nyid// dag pa'i bkod pa phun tshogs dbus// rin chen seng khri pad+ma dang*// zla nyi'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar steng*// rang rig hūm̐ mthing 'od 'bar las| |rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa// lte ba hūm̐ mthing gis mtshan las// 'od 'phros rgyal ba rnams mchod cing*// 'gro ba'i don byas slar 'dus pa// yongs gyur rang rig bla ma'i sku// rdo rje 'chang dbang nam mkha'i mdog

/dbu skra lcang lo gtsug tu bcings// rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs pas// dbu dang phyag zhabs mgul dpung snyan// do shal se mo do ska rags// bkod mdzes rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing*// sna tshogs dar gyis bklubs pa ste// rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*// rdo rje dril bu bsnol 'khyud pa'i// pang du yum chen rdo rje snyems// sngo bsangs zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis// gri thod 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan// dbu skra lcang lo rgyab tu 'phyang*// zhabs gnyis pad skyil 'khril sbyor tshul| |yab yum dpral ba'i sku rdo rje// dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin// mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje ni// dmar po pad+ma dril bu 'dzin// thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje ni// mthing kha rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// yum gyi dpral bar sku yi ni// rdo rje ma dkar gri thod 'dzin// mgrin par gsung gi rdo rje ma// dmar mo gri thod 'dzin ma ste// thugs kar thugs kyi rdo rje ma// mthing kha gri thod 'dzin pa la// kun kyang dar dang rin chen rgyan// yab rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog bcings// yum rnams pad+ma'i skyil krung la// dbu skra lcang lo rgyab tu grol// longs sku nges pa lnga ldan tshul// snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa// 'od kyi lus can gsal bar bsgom// thun gnyis pa'o// lha rnams kun las 'od 'phros pas// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas// dbang lha'i rnam par spyan drangs mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes pas gsol btab dbang lha rnams// bum pa bdud rtsis gang thogs nas// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas dbang bskur dri ma dag /chu lhag gyen du 'khyil ba las// gtso bo yab yum dbu la ni// bde gshegs rigs lngas rgyas gdab cing*// sku yi rdo rje yab yum la// rnam par snang mdzad dag gis brgyan// gsung gi rdo rje yab yum la// snang ba mtha' yas kyis rgyas gdab// thugs kyi rdo rje yab yum la// mi bskyod rgyal pos rgyas btab nas// dbang lha rnams ni gtso la thim// slar yang lha rnams gnas gsum du// 'khor lo dkar dang pad+ma dmar// rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa// 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ yig dkar// pad+ma'i lte bar āḥyig dmar// rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ yig mthing*// de ltar gsal snang thon pa dang*// thams cad 'od lus gsal stong sku// ma yeng rtse gcig bsgom par bya'o// thun gsum pa'o// slar yang dpral ba'i oṃ rnams las// 'od dkar 'phros pas rang lus kyi// sgrib sbyangs sprul sku thob bsam zhing*// oṃ yig brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas// mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar 'phros// rang gi ngag gi sgrib sbyangs nas// longs sku thob bsam āḥyig bzla| |snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od mthing 'phros// yid sgrib sbyangs nas chos sku thob// hūm̐ gi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya// slar yang gnas gsum yi ge las// 'od 'phros 'gro rnams lus ngag yid// sgrib pa sbyangs nas sku gsum po// thob pa'i dmigs pa so sor bya// de tshe yi ge gsum po yang*// so sor brgya stong ci 'grub bzla// thun bzhi pa'o// slar yang gnas gsum yi ge las// dkar dmar mthing kha'i 'od 'phros pas// phyi snod 'jig rten 'og min zhing*// nang bcud 'gro drug rdo rje 'chang*// yab yum sku gsung thugs rdo rje// la sogs rang 'drar dmigs pa yis// gnas rnams phyag mtshan dang bcas gsal// rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyis// dbang lha spyan drangs mchod gsol gdab// dbang bskur so sor rgyas 'debs so// rang nyid ji bzhin der byas nas// kun gyi gnas gsum yi ge las// 'od 'phros stong gsum 'jig rten gyi// 'gro kun la yang de ltar sbyar| |kun gyi lus ni lha yab yum// ngag nas yig gsum 'brug ltar sgrog

/thugs ni mi g.yo ting 'dzin gsal// de ltar bsam byas yi ge gsum// brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa// ci 'grub ma yeng rtse gcig bzla// thun lnga pa'o// slar yang rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor slad// rang gi gnas gsum las spros pa'i// 'od kyis snod bcud rten brten pa// bsdus nas rang gi gnas gsum thim// dar cig yig gsum ci nus bzla// slar yang rang nyid yab yum gyi// sku lus stod smad nas zhu ba// rdo rje gsum gyi lhar thim zhing*// de yang sku yi rdo rje ni// gsung la thim zhing gsung rdo rje// thugs kyi rdo rje la thim tshe// thugs kyi rdo rje ma nyid ni// thugs kyi rdo rje yab la thim// yab kyang thugs ka'i rdo rje la// rdo rje hūm̐ la hūm̐ zhabs kyu// khog pa mgo bo zla tshes dang*// thig le nā da la thim nas// nā da de la sems gtad nas// dar cig ma yeng mnyam par bzhag /slar yang nā da mi dmigs ngang*// dus gsum kun rtog rgyun bcad nas// khyab gdal ye khyab ngang du bzhag /rjes su 'khor gsum yongs dag pa'i// bsngo smon dag gis rgyas btab nas// spyod lam chos dang mthun par bkol| |thun drug pa'o// de ltar lam zab bla sgrub kyi// nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol 'di// 'jig rten gsum mgon bla ma'i gsung*// ji bzhin chad dang lhag med par// chos kyi grags pa zhes bgyi bas// gzhan la phan snyam yi ger bkod| |dge des ma tshogs 'gro ba rnams// rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
